About this book

A rhyming read-aloud for ages 0–5 with your child’s name in six rhymes, a dedication and a reading pledge.

Whose Lap Today? is a personalized picture book for ages 0–5, printed to order as a hardcover or softcover. It is a warm, rhyming read-aloud about the best seats in town, made for one child. Their name is in six of the rhymes. Dad calls them up to the armchair, and Grandma saves them a seat. A big brother gives them a turn to sing “QUACK!” At the end of the day comes a sleepy “Goodnight.”

You choose one of four looks for the story’s child, their pronouns, who the book is from, and what they call Grandma (Nana, Abuela, Gigi and more). The family in the story is the same in every copy: Dad, Grandma, who uses a wheelchair, and a big brother. The first page is a personal dedication with your own gift message (or our warm default). Every spread has a short “Lap talk” idea for grown-ups. Pause and wait, say what you see and add one word, or offer a choice. Or stop before the fun word so your child can fill it in.

At the back are 5 simple lap games with safety notes. There is a “Books before screens” family reading pledge to sign together and a keepsake page for your child’s favorite laps.

The words are in English; names with accents (Sofía, Zoë, Ñico) print correctly. Each copy is printed on demand in 8.5 × 8.5 inch full color. It makes a lasting baby-shower, first-birthday or grandparent gift.

Questions

What is inside?

32 pages: title page, dedication, 12 rhyming spreads with your child’s name in six of them and a Lap talk idea on each, 5 lap games with safety notes, a family reading pledge and a keepsake page. Front and back covers carry the name.

What ages is it for?

0–5. It is a read-aloud, so you can start in the first months; the rhymes and the pointing and counting games land best from about 1 to 5.

Does the family in the story look like mine?

You choose the look of the story’s child. The rest of the family is the same in every copy: Dad, Grandma (who uses a wheelchair) and a big brother, plus friends at the park. You can choose what the child calls Grandma. Many families read it as “a family full of laps”, not a portrait of their own.

Is there a Spanish edition?

Not yet. The words are in English, and accented names print correctly. Choose “Abuela” for Grandma if you like. The grown-up page says: talk, sing and read in the language you know best.

Can it ship straight to the family as a gift?

Yes. Enter their address at checkout, and the book ships straight from the printer.

Can I see the book before it prints?

The product page shows every page of a sample copy. The name prints exactly as typed, so check the spelling before you pay. Books go to print automatically, so a book can’t be changed after checkout.

How does a printed book reach me?

Each copy is printed when you order it and shipped by the printer, with tracking by email. The time to print and deliver is shown at checkout before you pay.

What can I do with it?

Use it with your own household, as often as you like. Please share a link to this page rather than the files. License terms

What if something is wrong?

Our shipping and returns page sets out exactly what happens if a file is broken, a book arrives damaged, or something isn’t as described.
